payload.comment: Profiling stage is internally consistent and well-documented. Split sizes (89996/10004/7180) match official PathMNIST exactly; class-count sums verify per split. Imbalance ratio 1.634 is arithmetically correct (12885/7886). Provenance chain (MD5, per-split SHA-256, Zenodo DOI) is complete. The cross-center domain shift (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) and the severe test-set class-distribution skew (debris ~30×, stroma ~22×, smooth-muscle ~20× reduction) are correctly characterised as dataset risks rather than pipeline defects. Ambiguity notes for H&E label boundaries are appropriate and do not indicate a data-quality failure. No deterministic findings were raised, and none are warranted.
